name: model_index
summary: Walks /home/tom/models (283 GB across 33 collections: Qwen_Image_Edit, TencentARC_Pixal3D, gemma-4-E4B, marigold-normals, Marlin-2B, Qwen3-TTS, LTX2.3, Kolors-Virtual-Try-On, apple_DepthPro, Pixal3D, Flux2-Klein, LongCat-Video, melodyflow, Vocal-Isolator, facebook_sapiens-1b, SpaceTimeGPT, metaclip-2, flux_2_klein_4B_background_remove_lora, ...). Classifies each .safetensors/.ckpt/.pt/.gguf/.bin/.onnx by extension + dir + size bucket. Emits ParserCursor-compatible JSONL.
engine_pattern: bash + python3 json. Deterministic walk. Two classification axes (dir hint + filename hint + size bucket).

classification.small_model: size 100 MB - 2 GB without dir/name match

instructions: 6. token_router pulls from this when resolving a tier
7. workflow_card 'model_path' fields validate against this index
node_kinds_emitted: element name='root' depth=1 — per model root dir
element name='collection' depth=2 — per top-level model collection (e.g., apple_DepthPro/)
text name='readme_snippet' depth=3 — README.md first 20 lines
element name='model_file' depth=2 — per weight file (rel, kind, ext, size, mtime)
substrate: model_index (JSONL — joinable with comfy_dag and crystal chain)

inbound_callers: core/lib/token_router.py (transitively via model_registry — extends to include local /home/tom/models entries)

guarantees: Deterministic — same filesystem → same JSONL bytes
Walkable — ParserCursor reads identically to other chains
Classification heuristics documented in this card; reproducible
